The '''All Terrain Defense Pod''' ('''AT-DP''') was a bipedal [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]], a variant of the [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]]. It featured a heavily armored head with a single mobile [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] mounted beneath its chin, and narrow slits on the right and left sides of the cockpit, from which crewmembers could fire at flanking threats. The walker was deployed as a police vehicle on [[Planet/Legends|planets]] where rebel unrest seemed probable, as well as patrol missions. Overall, the AT-DP was quite similar to the [[All Terrain Advance Raider]] with which it shared the armored cockpit and central laser cannon.<ref name="IHB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The All Terrain Defense Pod was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity in the [[2014]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and published by [[becker&mayer!]].<ref name="IHB" /> Although it was released after April 2014's split of the [[canon]]/Legends continuities and the creation of the rule that any works released after that date are to be designated canon, becker&mayer! has confirmed that the ''Imperial Handbook'' is branded as ''Star Wars'' Legends, meaning it is not part of the current canon.<ref name="Facebook">{{Facebook|username=beckermayerbooks|url=beckermayerbooks/posts/865867973431390|name=[[becker&mayer!|Becker&mayer! Books]]|date=2014-09-12|quote=Hi Mark! Imperial Handbook is set in Legends.|archivefile=File:BeckerMayer-ImperialHandbookLegends-Facebook.png|nolive=1}} {{C|In response to: Does anyone know if this book is set in Legends? Or Canon?}}</ref> The [[All Terrain Defense Pod]] was developed for the canon television series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' based on an unused [[1979]] concept art by [[Joe Johnston]]<ref name="Rebels: The Visual Guide">''[[Star Wars Rebels: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> and had first appeared earlier that year in the browser [[Star Wars video games|game]] ''[[Star Wars Rebels: Ghost Raid]]''<ref name="Ghost Raid">{{SW|url=games-apps/star-wars-rebels-ghost-raid|text=''Star Wars Rebels: Ghost Raid''|int=Star Wars Rebels: Ghost Raid|nolive=1}}</ref> released on [[July 16]], 2014.<ref name="Release">{{WebCite|url=http://www.jedinews.co.uk/misc/articles/new-star-wars-rebels-ghost-raid-disney-game|text=New ''Star Wars Rebels: Ghost Raid'' Disney Game|author=LaSalata, Justin|date=2014-07-16|archivedate=20200602191041}}</ref>
